digest.component_or_area: jira integration adapter layer / backend port
propositions: Jira Cloud and Data Center backends share code through a forked adapter package that creates duplication and cross-adapter private imports, violating the Backend port contract
Field maps, sanitizers, and value mappings are defined in multiple places (jira_fields.py, outbound_fields.py, config.py) and have already drifted (e.g. deleted-key mismatch)
Location-pinned modules (adf.py, outbound_fields.py, comment_limits.py) loaded by path cannot be relocated without breaking the dynamic loader unless the loader itself is re-taught

DC requires a deduplicated shared layer (jira_family/) with contracts parameterized by deployment (RichTextCodec for ADF vs wiki/plain-text, UserIdentityModel for accountId vs name) rather than two forks
DC connection must enforce https URLs by default with explicit allow_insecure override, never disable TLS cert verification, and read credentials from environment only (JIRA_PAT) not config files
Live Jira 8.17.1 harness validates bidirectional reconciliation (DC issue creation syncs inbound, local edits sync outbound) with zero unhandled exceptions and convergence on repeated passes
